settings.heading: Book your style session
settings.subheading: Sit down with a stylist, choose your fabric and cut, and leave with a suit made only for you.

settings.title: Book a Style Session
settings.text: Start with a free one-on-one consultation with our design team via video call or WhatsApp. We understand your vision, occasion, body type, and every detail that matters to you.

settings.title: Design & Customise
settings.text: Choose your fabric, embroidery patterns, colours, silhouette, and every finishing detail on our Designer Desk. Every piece is built entirely around your preferences - nothing is off the shelf.

settings.title: Digital Mockup & Approval
settings.text: Before a single stitch is placed, you receive a full 2D and 3D digital mockup of your garment. Review, request changes, and only approve when you're completely satisfied.

settings.title: Handcrafted & Delivered Worldwide
settings.text: Our master tailors bring your design to life with live photo and video updates throughout production. Once complete, your order is packed with care and shipped fast to your door - anywhere in the world.

settings.heading: How it works
settings.intro: Three simple steps from first call to final fitting.

settings.heading: Start with a favourite

settings.heading: Pick a time
settings.text_intro: Choose a slot that works for you. Sessions are free and last about 30 minutes.

settings.question: How long does a custom suit take?
settings.answer: Most pieces are ready 7 to 10 weeks after your final measurements.

settings.question: Is the style session free?
settings.answer: Yes. The session is free and there is no obligation to order.

settings.question: Can I join by video?
settings.answer: Yes. You can attend in person or by video call.
